shots.headline: Everything you copy, one shortcut away
shots.sub: Search your clipboard history, see each copy before you use it, and paste it back where you were typing.

callout.title: Clipboard Manager
callout.label: ⇧⌘C, in any app
callout.body: Colours, links, files and screenshots — each previewed as what it is.

shots.headline: Private by design
shots.sub: Your history stays on this Mac, stored encrypted, and nothing leaves it — the extension has no network access.

callout.title: Clipboard Manager
callout.label: Never recorded
callout.body: Anything a password manager marks as secret — Lumi drops it before the extension hears of it.

shots.headline: Keep it your way
shots.sub: How long to keep, how to search, whether to read text in images — and one key to bring it all back.
